hero.title: Run AI chat on your own infrastructure.
hero.lede: Velin brings accounts, API keys and chat history together in one place. Model calls go through Ollama, so your data never leaves your server.

example.label: Example API request and response
example.answer: Hello! How can I help you?

steps.title: Your first reply in three steps
steps.lede: Open your account, create a key and send your first message.
steps.oneBody: Choose a username and password. Sessions are managed with short-lived JWTs and separate refresh tokens.
steps.twoBody: Create a key for live or test use. It is shown only once and stored in the database as a SHA-256 hash.
steps.threeBody: Open a chat and send your message. The last 20 messages are sent to the model as context, and the reply is saved to your chat history.

infrastructure.title: Your data stays on your server.
infrastructure.body: Messages are stored in PostgreSQL and model calls go directly to Ollama on your server. Every request carries only your own chat history; no one else's data is accessible.

auth.note: Accounts, API keys and chat history in one place. Your data stays on your own server.

form.loginSecurity: Sessions are protected with short-lived JWTs.
form.registerSecurity: Your password is hashed with bcrypt and never stored in plain text.
